title: Aviva ends 25-year JV with Dabur, takes 100% ownership
body: Aviva plc has completed the buyout of partner Dabur Invest Corp from their Indian life insurance joint venture, Aviva Life Insurance Company India. The British insurer previously held 74% of the venture, with Dabur holding the remaining 26%. Following the transaction, Aviva owns 100% of Aviva India. The joint venture was formed in 2001. AZB & Partners advised Dabur on the transaction.
